label: demo/CI fixture pack — not live web intel

events.title: Vertical light column reported over Seattle, WA
events.description: Eyewitnesses describe a perfectly straight pillar of blue-white light lasting 3-7 minutes. No aircraft or weather explanation. Multiple independent phone videos.

events.title: Circular tear appears in sky above Los Angeles, CA
events.description: A dark circular region opened for ~90 seconds. Stars visible inside the circle were wrong. Two pilots also reported it.

events.title: Low-frequency door slam heard across London, UK
events.description: A deep concussive sound followed by 8 seconds of complete silence. Reported by thousands. No explosion registered.

events.title: Mass glitch event reported downtown Tokyo, JP
events.description: Hundreds of people simultaneously saw buildings flicker and a brief different skyline. Social media spiked for 11 minutes.

events.title: Portal-like shimmer observed over water near New York, NY
events.description: A 4m tall rectangular distortion hovering over the surface. Reflected light behaved incorrectly. Lasted 22 minutes.
